name: Kilobat CLI
tagline: Local macOS network diagnostics for agents.
description: Kilobat CLI provides Wi-Fi, DNS and host-connection diagnostics through a local stdio MCP server. The CLI is GPL-3.0-only; the separate Kilobat desktop app is proprietary. Some Wi-Fi information requires the desktop app and Location permission, and system-changing actions may require authorization.

install.notes: macOS 14 or later. Install the CLI first with `brew install seifip/kilobat/kilobat`; this source build requires Xcode 16 or newer. Then run this command in a terminal to open the Cline MCP setup wizard.
